The Transparent Assessment Framework (TAF) is the ICES platform for recording, documenting and running the stock assessments and analyses that support scientific advice. This site describes how the system is designed, where it is heading, and how the work is progressing.

## TAF readiness

```{r}
#| include: false
source("status/_plot.R")
repos <- read.csv("_generated/taf-repos.csv")
```

The stock assessment repositories by year and [TAF readiness level](system/readiness-level.qmd): `r sum(repos$trl >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)` of the `r nrow(repos)` have their code on GitHub, and `r sum(repos$trl >= 2, na.rm = TRUE)` of those pass the QC test. The dotted blocks are the published assessments of the year, repeated on top of the not published to show the total. The assessments behind each bar are listed under [TAF readiness](status/readiness.qmd).

```{r}
#| echo: false
readiness_chart(readiness_assessments(repos))
```

Day-to-day task status lives on the [TAFGOV and TAF team project board](https://github.com/orgs/ices-eg/projects/10). Requests and bug reports go to the [issue tracker](https://github.com/ices-eg/wg_WGTAFGOV/issues).
